cohort: The study included 44 pregnant women with severe preeclampsia (SPE group) and 20 healthy pregnant women (NC group) who underwent puerperal delivery.
finding: The study found that let-7a expression was significantly lower and TNF-a expression was significantly higher in the placental tissue of the SPE group compared to the control group, with let-7a and TNF-a being negatively correlated, suggesting let-7a may participate in SPE by negatively regulating TNF-a.
cross-section timing: At the time of puerperal delivery
birth_weight: SPE group: 2507.02 ± 161.46 g; Control group: 3592.12 ± 153.05 g
